summary.text: Bennie Foster Jr., an independent educator and business owner raised in Jackson, Mississippi, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Mississippi's 2nd District to Bennie Thompson.
He describes decades of work creating youth programs in violence intervention, music and art, business incubation, and ministry, and says he returned to Jackson about five years ago.

paragraphs.text: Foster says he was raised in Jackson. He earned a bachelor's degree from Jackson State University and graduated from Strayer University, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as educator and business owner.
He describes spending decades as an educator, creating programs in youth violence intervention, music and art, business incubation, and ministry.
Foster says he and his wife lived in Florida before he returned to Jackson about five years ago. He was on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the 2nd District seat as an independent.
He campaigned on a 'People Over Politics' message.
Foster received 2.4% of the vote to Bennie Thompson's 67.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
